jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation

* Sales and inventory management

* Employee staffing, training, and development

* Financial management

* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

**Required Qualifications**

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill

Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

**Education**

High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$29.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Cloud Partners
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Enterprises and developers reach Claude through the clouds they already run on: AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft. The cloud partner marketing team works with all three partners to put Claude in front of the people who build with it and the leaders who buy it.

As Program Manager, Cloud Partners, you'll own the programs and campaigns that run across those partnerships: technical webinars, hands-on developer workshops, and digital campaigns. You'll set the program strategy and calendar, decide which formats we invest in, and build each one so it can run on every cloud and in every region. You'll report to the leader of cloud partner marketing and work alongside the marketing leads for each cloud. They own the partner relationships and joint plans, and you'll own the scalable programs that deliver against them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with wide scope. You'll design new programs and run them yourself, then direct agencies, regional teams, and partners to scale what works. You'll be measured on the pipeline your programs generate and influence, and on how deeply they reach target accounts and technical audiences.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the strategy and calendar for cross-cloud programs, planned with the marketing lead for each cloud and tied to target accounts and pipeline goals
* Lead the technical webinar programs we run with cloud partners, from topic and speaker strategy through promotion, regional and on-demand versions, and follow-up
* Build a repeatable developer workshop model and scale it across cities and regions with cloud partners, systems integrators, and Anthropic's technical teams
* Lead digital campaigns, including audience strategy, creative briefs, budget pacing, and optimization
* Own the budget for your programs and recommend how market development funds (MDF) are invested across them
* Direct agencies and vendors end to end, including scoping, briefs, quality, and spend
* Set the goals for each program before it launches, report on pipeline and account reach, and recommend what to scale, change, or stop
* Build the follow-up motion so program leads turn into opportunities and pipeline
* Work directly with program and marketing counterparts at cloud partners, balancing their goals with Anthropic's priorities
* Turn what works into playbooks and self-serve tools that regional and partner teams can run, using Claude to speed up repeatable work

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Have owned B2B marketing programs end to end across several channels, including webinars, in-person events or workshops, and paid digital campaigns
* Have run co-marketing programs with a cloud provider or a comparable technology partner, including joint planning and multi-party approvals
* Have managed program budgets, agencies or vendors, and partner funding such as MDF
* Can build, track, and report on campaigns in a CRM and a marketing automation platform
* Can analyze registration, attendance, budget, and pipeline data in spreadsheets or a reporting tool, and turn it into a clear recommendation
* Have planned and optimized paid campaigns on LinkedIn or a comparable platform, with an agency or an internal growth team
* Have led programs across sales, product, technical, and partner teams you did not manage
* Write clearly and precisely for executives, partners, and technical audiences
* Can run several programs at once without dropping quality, in an environment where priorities and dates change
* Care about the societal impacts of AI and are excited about helping organizations adopt AI responsibly

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Have worked in marketing at a major cloud provider, or have marketed a product through one
* Have marketed to developers and IT decision-makers as well as business leaders
* Have built a program model from scratch and scaled it through agencies, partners, or regional teams
* Have run programs across North America, EMEA, and APAC
* Have built account-based programs with sales teams against a named account list
* Understand cloud marketplaces, co-sell, and consumption-based business models
* Have marketed AI, data, or developer products
* Have used Claude or other AI tools to scale your own marketing work

**Role-specific policy:** For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or Seattle office at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. If based in Seattle, this role will require traveling to the San Francisco office once a month. Additionally, this role will also require travel up to 20% of the time for partner meetings and partner events.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

LiveX AI is looking for a proactive, technical Customer Success Manager to own the post-sales experience for our mid-market customers. You will be the day-to-day owner of a book of existing accounts, so that our Sales and Solution Engineering teams can focus on new and strategic accounts. Sales and Solution Engineering continue to own new customer acquisition and the relationship with strategic accounts, while you support strategic accounts with day-to-day work such as version updates, configuration, and account analysis. Depending on experience, you may also manage some of our larger accounts.

This is a technical, customer-facing role. You will own anything in a customer's account that does not require a code change: configuring and updating their AI agents, resolving support issues, and keeping their deployment on the latest version of our product. For your existing accounts, you will also be the first point of contact in customer meetings, collecting information and addressing concerns before bringing in Solution Engineering when needed.

Beyond keeping accounts stable and healthy, you will review each account every week to find ways to improve results and to spot upsell opportunities, and you will keep customers up to date on new LiveX AI offerings. When an opportunity comes up, you will help close it.

Years of experience matter less to us than technical ability and initiative. This role suits someone who is technically curious, takes ownership without being asked, and enjoys working directly with customers in a fast-paced startup.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Post-Sales Technical Support**

* Get involved with new accounts after launch, and take full ownership from Sales and Solution Engineering once the deployment is stable (typically 30+ days after onboarding) and the customer is happy.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned mid-market accounts after deployment.
* Provide high-quality technical support and own the resolution of any issue that does not require a code change, such as agent configuration, knowledge base updates, conversation flows, and troubleshooting.
* Escalate issues that require engineering work to Solution Engineering with clear context and reproduction steps, and follow them through to resolution.

**Customer Meetings**

* Lead regular meetings with your existing accounts as the first-line contact, gathering requirements, feedback, and technical details.
* Address customer questions and concerns directly where you can, and hand off to Solution Engineering with a clear summary when deeper technical work is needed.

**Product Updates & Service Quality**

* Keep every customer's AI agent up to date with the latest product version so customers always receive a high-quality service.
* Plan and communicate updates with customers, test changes before release, and confirm everything works as expected afterward.

**Account Analysis & Growth**

* Review each account weekly, using conversation data and usage metrics, to identify areas for improvement and upsell opportunities.
* Share findings and recommendations with customers and with the internal team.
* Keep customers informed about the latest LiveX AI offerings and features, and explore where they could add value for each account.
* Bring upsell and expansion opportunities to the Account Executive, who decides how each one is handled, and close deals yourself when the AE hands them to you.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 1+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Support, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, or Account Management. Recent graduates with strong technical skills and relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong technical aptitude: comfortable configuring software products, troubleshooting issues, and learning new technology quickly.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the confidence to lead parts of customer meetings.
* Analytical skills to review account data, spot trends, and turn them into concrete recommendations.
* A proactive work style: you take ownership, follow up without being reminded, and look for problems before customers report them.

**Preferred**

* Experience selling, upselling, or closing expansion deals.
* Experience with AI, conversational AI, or B2B SaaS products.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, or basic scripting.
* Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Mid-market customers receive fast, high-quality support, and most issues are resolved without involving Solution Engineering.
* Every customer's AI agent runs on the latest product version.
* Sales and Solution Engineering spend their time on new and strategic accounts rather than ongoing support for existing ones.
* Each account has a weekly review with clear improvement actions and documented upsell opportunities.
* Customer satisfaction and retention stay high, and existing accounts grow through upsells.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Base Salary:** $100,000 - $130,000 annually
* **Variable Compensation:** May be eligible for performance-based incentives, such as a bonus or commission, in accordance with the company's applicable plans.
* **Equity:** Stock options may be offered as part of the total compensation package.
* **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and other company-sponsored benefits.

Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, role responsibilities, and internal equity.

This position requires working from our San Francisco office, Monday through Thursday, with close collaboration across the team.

If you have at least 3 years of account management experience, enjoy talking to people, are not afraid to pick up the phone, have a natural sales mindset, and want to grow your career beyond traditional customer support, we'd love to meet you!

jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sable**
---------------

Sable built Aidan, the first AI employee who can lead customer calls using realtime voice, vision, and browser use. Aidan runs a live, two-way conversation inside a real product environment, clicking through the product like a human, watching the user's screen, and adapting the journey on the fly. Every conversation feeds a self-improving context graph we call the Brain, so Aidan gets smarter with each call.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for an Executive Assistant / Office Manager to make our CEO's day and our office run smoothly. You'll report directly to our co-founder and CEO. You'll bring structure to a busy calendar, keep communication and commitments moving, and handle the practical details that help the whole team do its best work. This is our first dedicated EA / Office Manager, and the role is in person in San Francisco, Monday to Friday.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the CEO's calendar: prioritize requests, coordinate meetings across time zones, prepare the CEO for what's next, and protect time for the most important work
* Keep communication moving: track requests and commitments, follow up with the right people, and make sure decisions turn into action
* Arrange travel, dinners, events, and other logistics for the CEO and the team, including occasional personal logistics handled with discretion
* Keep the office welcoming and functional by coordinating visitors, supplies, and day-to-day needs
* Create a smooth, welcoming experience for new hires and people joining us for work trials by coordinating schedules, access, equipment, and day-of logistics
* Maintain order across expenses, records, renewals, and recurring administrative tasks

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Roughly 1-3 years of experience in executive support, office management, administration, or a similarly hands-on operations role
* Exceptionally organized, and you follow through without needing repeated reminders
* A clear writer and a warm communicator who exercises good judgment with confidential information
* Someone who notices what needs doing, takes initiative, and stays calm when priorities change
* You enjoy supporting people and making a busy workplace feel well run
* Excited to work in person, five days a week, Monday to Friday, with a fast-moving team in San Francisco

jobs.title: Bilingual Case Manager-BRC
jobs.description:
Position: Case Manager, BRC (Bilingual)

Location: Boccardo Reception Center (2011 Little Orchard Street, San Jose, Ca)

Employment Type: Regular Full Time, Non-Exempt

Compensation: $32.20/Hourly

**ABOUT HOMEFIRST**

Established in 1980, HomeFirst™ is a nonprofit organization passionately working to end homelessness. We serve the Bay Area community through low-barrier programming and systems leadership – meeting each person where they are by offering support and resources that address immediate and long-term housing needs. With nearly 45 years of experience, we view housing as a fundamental human right and understand that solving homelessness requires a collaborative effort.

**OUR VALUES**

* Kindness: We act with empathy toward others.
* Passion: We ignite change to fulfill our mission.
* Excellence: We deliver exceptional service to our communities.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The goal of HomeFirst’s case management services at the Boccardo Reception center is to provide access to resources and housing for homeless individuals in Santa Clara County, (San Jose) California. The case management services will achieve this goal by providing participants with comprehensive supportive services to help link them to a network of community resources such as: psychiatric, medical, employment, housing, income, Housing Problem Solving (HPS), family reunification, and other services with permanent housing as the goal.

**QUALITIES**:

The Case Manager is passionate about serving others and sees themself in a helping profession long term. They are pro-active and responsive to the needs of our participants, meeting them “where they’re at” and bridging the gap between the individual and our services.

They manage their time well and demonstrate strong organizational abilities. With the support of program leadership, the Case Manager participates in our culture of learning and increases their knowledge of evidence-based practices over the course of their employment. Together, we model the values and principles of HomeFirst within the agency and broader community.

HomeFirst is a diverse company in a diverse field, and the Case Manager seeks to work with people from a variety of social and economic backgrounds. They are a highly collaborative member of our participant services team and enjoy a team-oriented work environment.

**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS**

This role reports to the Program Manager.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain a case load as a case manager of homeless individuals in Santa Clara County by providing direct case management to program participants.
* Provide excellent customer service to those referred, welcoming them to the shelter and providing a tour of the BRC facility and amenities
* Provide community-based case management services to program participants
* Conduct participant intakes per HomeFirst requirements, including assessments - needs assessment, housing support, services plans, and Biopsychosocial
* Link participants to Santa Clara County Coordinated Entry System via completion of Vulnerability Index & Service Prioritization and Decision-Making Tool (VI-SPDAT)
* Educate participants on HMIS client portal features and enrollment
* Provide appropriate referrals and linkage to community services, including mainstream benefits and access to medical and behavioral services
* Conduct ongoing reassessments of the participants’ needs and initiate referrals to appropriate BRC programs
* Manage bed list and waitlists, to ensure program maintains capacity (DTHBP)
* Works with program participants to develop and implement an individual case management and housing plan, and provide support to help them achieve their housing goals
* Work collaboratively with other team members as applicable to communicate interventions with the participant
* Collaborate with community partners regarding support services for clients
* Engage in case conferencing with a multi-disciplinary team approach
* Utilize supervision appropriately, maintaining open lines of communication and providing updates on intake status
* Know and implement agency and program policies and procedures
* Properly report any suspected cases of abuse
* Maintain professional relations and conduct
* Maintain thorough, accurate records of case management activities with every program participant, in the HMIS system
* Meets regularly with program participants at a frequency determined by their needs
* Assist participants with transportation needs to critical appointments
* Support participants in becoming document ready for benefits and housing applications
* Documents, via progress notes in HMIS, all case management activity within 3 business days and maintains all other case file paperwork and documentation
* Attend all meetings and trainings relevant to this position
* Assist with other duties assigned

**BENEFITS**

HomeFirst provides comprehensive benefits, including 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage and additional wellness options like chiropractic care, mental health support, pet insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program. We offer a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous matching, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits, and workers’ compensation. Employees enjoy 12 holidays, sick leave, and PTO starting at 15 days annually, increasing with tenure, plus 8 hours of civic engagement leave annually to volunteer.

**ORGANIZATIONAL EQUITY STATEMENT**

At HomeFirst, diversity, equity, and inclusion guide our services, workplace, and decisions. Recognizing housing as a social justice issue, we prioritize equitable practices, honor lived experiences and uphold dignity for all. By fostering belonging, accountability, and continuous improvement, we embed DEI values in our processes, recruitment, and leadership, striving for excellence at every level.

HomeFirst is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and considers qualified applicants for employme

jobs.title: Project Manager (Volunteer Role)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an organized Project Manager to join our team in a volunteer capacity. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals passionate about non-profit work, leadership, and community engagement to contribute meaningfully to our initiatives.

The Project Manager will oversee and track project status, coordinate the project schedule with team members to ensure all task delivery dates remain on target, and support organizational growth through effective management and communication. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership and organizational skills, experience using Google Workspace, and familiarity with collaboration tools such as Slack, and other project tracking methods to facilitate smooth workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and track project timelines, key dates, and milestones to ensure all deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Update project schedules based on new or adjusted tasks.
* Serve as a liaison among internal teams and team leads to ensure consistent communication and progress.
* Maintain detailed records of project activities, decisions, and outcomes.
* Identify potential delays or issues and communicate updates or solutions proactively.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Excellent organizational and time management skills; ability to track multiple project timelines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with team members and partners.
* Proficiency with digital collaboration tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and project management platforms).
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through on assigned tasks.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a virtual environment.
* Previous experience in a non-profit, volunteer, or community development setting is a plus.
* Passion for social impact and community development aligned with the Brickers Foundation’s mission.

**Why Volunteer?**

* Gain hands-on experience managing real-world projects and partnerships within the non-profit sector.
* Collaborate with the Foundation’s network of like-minded professionals, driving social impact across communities.
* Develop skills in project coordination, scheduling, and stakeholder management, or mentor other volunteers to do the same.
* Make a meaningful contribution to advancing the Foundation’s mission of empowerment, equity, and opportunity.

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Jamison Professional Services, Inc. (“Jamison”) is currently seeking a qualified and motivated candidate for the position of **Off-Site Program Manager**.  
  
**Location:**  
Off-site, supporting a team based in Ashburn, VA. Meetings may be held in person, by phone, or via Google Meet or Microsoft Teams, as required.  
  
**Schedule:**  
Part-time, as needed. The solicitation lists 24 hours per year. The expected time commitment is subject to confirmation.  
  
**DESCRIPTION OF SERVICES:**  
The Off-Site Program Manager oversees three Administrative Support II employees. The Program Manager serves as Jamison’s point of contact for staffing, coverage, and performance and works with designated Government representatives to address workload, schedules, and service issues.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Supervise, coach, and develop assigned employees to improve performance and service quality. Resolve employee grievances and take disciplinary action when necessary.
* Meet with Government representatives as needed to discuss work assignments, schedules, workloads, and issues requiring resolution.
* Conduct monthly meetings with assigned staff to review workloads, plan upcoming work, and resolve issues.
* Prepare and submit progress reports.
* Coordinate coverage and arrange for a qualified, security-cleared replacement when needed for an absence expected to exceed two business days. Coordinate interim coverage with existing staff while replacement personnel await security approval and system access.
* Assist with collecting and submitting required personnel security documentation.

**REQUIRED AND DESIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**  
**Required:**

* Five years of demonstrated experience performing administrative support work and leading administrative support personnel.
* Five years of experience managing administrative personnel.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Meet, and experience using cloud-based tools for tracking, reporting, and collaboration.
* Proficiency with web browsers, Adobe Acrobat, virtual meeting tools, and automated administrative systems, including travel, time and attendance, and other data-entry systems.
* Ability to learn agency-specific systems quickly and train and mentor staff in their use.
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, including the ability to coach staff on grammar, punctuation, and standard office documents.
* Experience mediating workplace issues, familiarity with the Government Style Manual, and strong oral and written communication skills across organizational levels.

**Desired:**

* Bachelor’s degree in any field or postsecondary training.

**Schedule:**  
The Program Manager must be available for monthly staff meetings, progress reporting, and coordination with Government representatives as needed. The solicitation lists **24 hours per year**, and Jamison will confirm the expected time commitment once the agency clarifies the requirement.  
  
**Clearance Level Required:** Employment is contingent upon successfully completing any required background checks, in accordance with applicable law.  
  
**JAMISON CORPORATE OVERVIEW:**  
Jamison Professional Services, Inc. (Jamison) is a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) headquartered in metropolitan Atlanta, Georgia. We specialize in providing professional management, administrative, healthcare, court reporters and transcriptionist experts, and document/ record and telehealth operational support solutions to U.S. Government, State, and commercial clients. Jamison is a nationwide professional staff augmentation company, that helps commercial clients and government agencies expand their talent acquisition reach by sourcing, assessing, developing, and managing the talent that enables them to be successful.  
Jamison offers a wide range of employment opportunities in the commercial and government sectors. We seek employees who share our values of service excellence, integrity, and professionalism.  
Jamison affords equal employment opportunity to all individuals, regardless of race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, medical condition, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Our employees, as well as applicants and others with whom we do business, will not be subjected to sexual, racial, religious, ethnic, or any other form of unlawful harassment and/or discrimination. In addition, Jamison adheres to the equal employment opportunity requirements of all states and localities in which it does business.  
Jamison’s commitment to equal opportunity is applied through every aspect of the employment relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, selection, placement, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, termination, and all other matters of employment.  
Applicants may be required to successfully complete an online assessment to determine qualifications for positions requiring specific skills.  
All applications must be submitted through our application system at: https://www.jps-online.com/apply-now/

jobs.title: Executive Assistant and Studio Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The Stern Studio LLC is an awarded luxury residential and hospitality interior design studio cofounded by mother/daughter duo Meryl and Rachel Stern, with 30+ years of expertise and generational vision. We create deeply personal spaces that reflect our clients' individuality through intense understanding of who they are and how they choose to live, specializing in artistic luxury and craft. We value creativity, collaboration, thoughtful execution and an uncompromising commitment to excellence.

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, resourceful and proactive professional to support our principals and manage the administrative, operational and social media functions of our growing studio. The Executive Assistant and Studio Operations Coordinator is a part-time remote position, with flexible hours.

**Responsibilities**

***Administrative & Studio Operations***

* Manage emails, calendars, scheduling, correspondence, and daily administrative support to the studio’s founders.
* Communicate professionally with clients, vendors, contractors, and industry partners.
* Coordinate vendor quotes, purchase orders, client proposals and invoices, payment tracking, and follow-ups using Studio Designer.
* Monitor logistics, priorities, deadlines and outstanding tasks to ensure timely follow-through.
* Handle tasks with discretion and attention to detail.
* Develop and streamline administrative systems to improve efficiency.
* Your impact: Reliable coordination helps the founders focus on design work and client needs.

***Social Media, Marketing & Communications***

* Manage Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant social media platform.
* Create, curate, and schedule engaging posts, stories, and reels.
* Develop content that reflects The Stern Studio's visual identity and luxury brand positioning.
* Organize project photography, digital assets, and marketing materials.
* Assist with website updates, portfolio presentations and public relations opportunities, including editorial features and industry events.
* Help grow the studio's online visibility, engagement, and brand awareness.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, administrative operations, studio management, or a related role.
* Exceptional organization and time-management skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Highly dependable, responsive, discreet, self-motivated, and resourceful.
* Strong follow-through and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Sound judgment when handling confidential business information.
* Experience with Studio Designer Software strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Canva and other supportive software for designers.
* Experience within interior design, architecture, luxury brands, or other creative industries preferred.

**IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?**

**This role is for you if:**

You love bringing order to a creative environment, take pride in the details, and naturally see what needs to be done before being asked.

You are equally comfortable managing invoices, coordinating with clients and vendors, organizing priorities, and contributing to a polished brand presence.

You are a problem-solver who values efficiency, accountability, and getting things done.

**This role is not for you if:**

You require step-by-step direction for every task, struggle with competing priorities, or prefer a highly structured environment where responsibilities rarely change.

*This is primarily an administrative and operations position, not an interior design role.*

Pay: $35.00 - $45.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 25.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Please send the following to design@thesternstudio.com:

1. Your resume  
2. A brief introduction highlighting your relevant experience.  
3. Your Brilliance Blueprint Quiz results, so we can better understand your natural strengths. Link: https://yourbrillianceblueprint.com/  
4. Examples of social media content or accounts you have managed, if applicable.

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: FBS (Mexico) - MarTech Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
**Farmers– where ambition meets opportunity.**

Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it’s a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people’s lives. Farmers employees deliver peace of mind when it matters most. The organization’s results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn’t just a goal – it’s a way of life for both the organization and every individual on the team. Farmers employees tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure their impact on the customers who trust them.

Join usand help power the success of Farmers. As a team member, you’ll collaborate with Farmers’ award-winning workforce, benefit from a culture of innovation and support and contribute to their mission of delivering protection and peace of mind to millions of U.S. customers.

Ready to make your mark? Discover Farmers’ vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The MarTech Specialist will help ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of the Marketing Technology ecosystem. This person will be responsible for testing platforms, validating integrations and data flows, identifying defects, and proactively resolving issues before they impact customers, marketing campaigns, or reporting.

The role works closely with Marketing, Media, Analytics, Technology, agencies, and external vendors to support lead generation, audience activation, digital measurement, customer journey orchestration, call tracking, and customer experience analytics.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop and maintain repeatable QA and testing processes.
* Validate integrations, APIs, webhooks, marketing tags, and audience workflows.
* Test conversion tracking, customer journeys, reporting outputs, and call-tracking implementations.
* Monitor data flows and ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across platforms.
* Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
* Perform root-cause analysis and troubleshoot technical and data-related issues.
* Create and maintain regression tests and release checklists.
* Establish monitoring processes to detect missing, duplicated, delayed, or inaccurate data.
* Partner with internal teams, agencies, and vendors to investigate and resolve issues.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the MarTech ecosystem.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in one of the following areas: Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering or related technical field

  

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of relevant professional experience required.
* 1-3 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, Marketing Technology, Digital Measurement, Data Validation, Analytics, or related fields.
  

**Language Requirements**

* Fluent English, both written and verbal.
  

**Core Skills**

Candidates should demonstrate experience in:

* Quality Assurance and Software Testing (Advanced)
* Test Planning and Regression Testing (Advanced)
* Data Validation and Reconciliation (Advanced)
* Root-Cause Analysis and Troubleshooting (Advanced)
* Defect Documentation and Management (Advanced)
* Process Documentation and Continuous Improvement (Advanced)
* Cross-Functional Communication (Advanced)
* Integration and API Testing (Intermediate)
* Marketing Technology and Digital Measurement (Intermediate)
  

**Technical Skills**

**Must Have:**

* Browser Developer Tools
* Postman/API Testing
* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Playwright, Selenium, or similar automation testing tools

**Nice to Have:**

* SQL
* Segment/CDP platforms
* Snowflake
* Invoca
* LiveRamp
  

**Preferred Background**

Candidates with experience in the following areas are highly preferred:

* **Software Quality Assurance**
* **Management Information Systems**
* **Digital Marketing**
* Statistics
* Data Science
* Marketing Automation Platforms
* CRM Systems
* Marketing Analytics
* Process Improvement Initiatives
  

Experience with **Google Marketing Platform**, **Segment (CDP)**, and broader **Marketing and Advertising Technology ecosystems** is highly desirable.

**Benefits**
  
  
This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

  

**Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures**

By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

* **Personal Data Processing:** The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies.

* **Legal Authorization to Work:** Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated.

* **Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest:** Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continua

jobs.description:

Our work environment includes:

* Growth opportunities

Our services are in high demand, and our hybrid sales model is unique for a 100% Commission sales role, allowing for a short sales cycle. You can earn NO CAP at the close of a transaction and receive recurring monthly income from Managed Services. As a Sales Professional, your primary responsibilities will be to drive sales and build relationships with new and existing clients.

Your main duties will include:

* Conducting pre-sales activities, including prospecting and lead generation

* Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients to ensure customer satisfaction
* Collaborating with the sales team to develop effective sales strategies
* Analyzing market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities
* Meeting or exceeding sales targets on a regular basis
* Providing excellent customer service and addressing client inquiries or concerns

* Familiarity with IT services, solutions, and industry terminology.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.

```Skills```  
To excel in this role, you should possess the following skills:

- Strong sales skills with a proven track record of success  
- Knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud  
- Familiarity with computer networking concepts and technologies  
- Project management skills to effectively manage client accounts and sales projects  
- Proficiency in Linux operating systems and related technologies  
- Ability to analyze market data and make informed business decisions  
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with clients  
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team to achieve sales goals

BONUS SKILLS:

CompTIA+

A background in AZURE

IT Technician

Digital Marketing

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for sales and technology, we would love to hear from you. Join our team today and take your career to new heights!

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance

* Vision insurance

jobs.description:
**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each major responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the major responsibilities.

**A. REQUIRED EDUCATION, SKILLS and EXPERIENCE**

* This position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Business and/or related field; and a minimum of 1 years of management experience.
* The individual must be proficient in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Must be able to work independently in cross-functional teams to achieve established goals.
* The individual must possess a valid driver’s license with insurance.

**B. LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* This individual must possess excellent communication and presentation skills both written and verbal in English & Chinese.
* Bilingual in English and Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin) is a must.

**C. MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* The candidate must be able to apply mathematical concepts to compute rates, discounts, percentages, and draw and interpret bar graphs.
* The individual must be able to define problems through data gathering and analysis, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
* He or she must be able to interpret an extensive variety of technical sales instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**D. PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* The individual must travel to meet business needs. The position requires at least 70% or more out time in the field visiting customers, wholesalers, restaurants, and supermarkets.
* Regularly required to use hands and fingers to perform daily job functions.
* Required to stand, sit, kneel, and walk when performing essential job functions.
* Occasional lifting and/or moving up to 50 pounds.

**E. WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

* The noise level in the work environment is light to moderate.
* The position is often in an office setting, traveling or at customer / user sites (restaurants, wholesalers, distributors, etc.).
* The position requires extensive travel – more than 50% of the time this position is expected to be out of the office.

薪资： 每年$120,000.00起

福利:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account

* Professional development assistance
